name: header-banner-announcement
title: Header Banner Announcement
description: Dismissable high-visibility notice banner pinned directly above the primary site navigation header.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Top Announcement Dismissal: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
